findings.description: Fresh independent contact-sheet and every-page full-size inspection. Historical source notes occupy separate paragraph blocks. Residual original letterspacing, reference grouping, literal source hyphens and OCR glyphs remain visible and disclosed; final page retains genuine historical source content before ruled apparatus.

documents.limitations: Every reader page inspected at full size and in contact sheets; exact source replays, preservation, note block separation and PDF fidelity independently repeated. Native OCR-PDF geometry checked within the declared constituent bounds. No source/helper/renderer writes; no original-print facsimile, lexical OCR collation, translation equivalence or new rights certification. Compact TeX applies 12.5pt leading while shared receipt options declare 13pt.
